# cycle_environments (Data Source)

Lists all Cycle environments in the hub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every environment in the hub.
data "cycle_environments" "all" {}

output "environment_names" {
  value = [for env in data.cycle_environments.all.environments : env.name]
}

output "live_environment_ids" {
  value = [
    for env in data.cycle_environments.all.environments : env.id
    if env.state == "live"
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) All environments in the hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `cluster` (String) The identifier of the cluster this environment is deployed into.
- `description` (String) The custom description of the environment.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this environment belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the environment.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the environment.
- `legacy_networking` (Boolean) Whether legacy networking mode is enabled on this environment.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the environment.
- `state` (String) The current state of the environment.
